     ("mobil oförändrad") gäller även denna oavsiktliga men redan existerande
     synlighet. .showcase-track har fortfarande ingen mobilstorlek (dess
     height/position-regler ligger kvar i 768px-blocket ovan) och kollapsar
     därför osynligt till 0px, precis som förut. */
  .showcase-detail{display:none;}
  .showcase-steps{display:contents;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd) p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- pris */
.pris-statement{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.pris-statement .body-30{max-width:60ch;margin-top:16px;font-weight:500;}
/* All placement lives in these classes (not inline styles) so the media
   queries below can actually win the cascade at each breakpoint. */
.pris-bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);grid-template-rows:auto auto;}
.pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 6;grid-row:1 / span 2;background:var(--mint);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.pris-tier{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;min-height:220px;}
.pris-tier-a{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:1;background:var(--paper);}
.pris-tier-b{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:2;background:var(--grey);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 2;grid-row:1;}
  .pris-tier-a{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;}
  .pris-tier-b{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .pris-lead,.pris-tier-a,.pris-tier-b{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;min-height:0;}
}
.price-label{max-width:34ch;font-size:15px;}
.price-value{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.price-value .unit{font-size:.5em;margin-left:2px;}
.price-value--text{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px);}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- kontakt (R5 §C: heron speglad) */
.kontakt-quad{
  position:relative;display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;min-height:100svh;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-areas:"ov oh" "nv nh";
}
.kontakt-q{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.kontakt-q--ov{grid-area:ov;background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;}
/* R6 §4: headline-40 is tuned for a single "jätteord" (hero, case names) -
   at this cell's half-page width, a four-word sentence in it ran past the
   ÖV/ÖH seam (measured x>720 at 1440, into the card's own space). A
   smaller, dedicated clamp - same family as the old kontakt-giant's - fits
   three lines comfortably inside the cell at 1440/1280/768, verified with
   getBoundingClientRect against the cell box, not eyeballed. */
.kontakt-q--ov h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.75rem, 1.1rem + 2.6vw, 3.4rem);line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:500;max-width:12ch;
}
.kontakt-q--ov p{max-width:32ch;font-size:15px;}
.kontakt-q--oh{grid-area:oh;background:var(--paper);}
.kontakt-q--nv{grid-area:nv;background:var(--grey);padding:0;}
.kontakt-q--nh{grid-area:nh;background:var(--mint);}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* R6 §7: nh gets more room than ov/nv (was the same minmax(60vw) as
     both) - a 3D Y-axis rotation's perspective projection genuinely bulges
     a flat card's rendered bounding box taller at the near edge as it
     turns (measured: +/-28px top/bottom at 1200px perspective, still
     +/-24px at 3000px - foreshortening a rotated rectangle really does
     grow its axis-aligned bbox, not a rounding artefact), and centring an
     88%-wide card in a 60vw-tall row left only ~27px clearance to the
     subline above - not enough to survive that bulge at any angle in the
     0-180deg sweep. */
  .kontakt-quad{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(60vw,auto) minmax(76vw,auto) minmax(60vw,auto);grid-template-areas:"ov" "nh" "nv";min-height:auto;}
  .kontakt-q--oh{display:none;}
}

/* the card sits on the crossing of all four quadrants (a grid item that
   spans the full 2x2 and centres itself), mirroring heron's own card. On
   mobile it drops into the mint cell's own grid area instead, 88% wide. */
/* R6 §4/§7: centred on the FULL 2x2 crossing put the card's top edge only
   ~15-50px below the headline row at rest, with zero margin for the flip's
   lift or the hover-tilt's foreshortening - both could (and did, measured)
   bring the card within single-digit px of "verksamhet.". Spanning only
   the LOWER row (grid-row:2, still centred horizontally on the vertical
   seam = still "on the crossing") puts the card inside the NV/NH half
   entirely, with a full row-height of clearance above it before ÖV even
   starts. */
.kontakt-card-anchor{
  grid-column:1 / 3;grid-row:2;place-self:center;z-index:5;
  width:min(32vw,460px);aspect-ratio:85/55;perspective:1200px;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .kontakt-card-anchor{grid-area:nh;place-self:center;width:80%;}
}
.kontakt-card-tilt{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
.card-flip2{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;}
.card-flip2 button.face{margin:0;padding:6%;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
.card-flip2 button.face:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.face-back-hit{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;}
.face-back-hit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:2px;}
.card-back-content{position:relative;z-index:1;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;pointer-events:none;}
.card-back-content a{pointer-events:auto;}
.card-back-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:4px;}
.card-back-links a{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;width:max-content;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- footer */
.footer-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0 0 0 var(--cellpad);height:34vw;max-height:340px;min-height:200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;}
.footer-mark{font-size:clamp(80px,16vw,220px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.06em;}
.footer-strip{padding:18px var(--cellpad);background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.footer-strip a{text-decoration:underline;font-size:14px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- resolve (dither -> color) */
.img-cell{position:relative;}
/* R3: §3 dither -> colour grid-stagger. The tile grid sits over the
   already-visible colour layer; each tile shows one slice of the dither
   image and fades on its own random-order schedule, so the resolve reads
   as pixels dissolving away rather than a wipe. Built once at init from
   the existing .dither-layer <img> (see buildTileGrid in the script). */
.tile-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;pointer-events:none;}
.tile-grid > span{display:block;background-repeat:no-repeat;will-change:opacity;}
.color-layer{clip-path:none;}

/* R3: seam-anchored decorations, all created/positioned by the script. */
.seam-line{position:absolute;background:var(--mint);pointer-events:none;z-index:3;}
/* the crosshair seam-draw is a 2x2-grid flourish; hero-stage stacks to one
   column under 768px (see .hero-stage media query above), so the same
   absolute-positioned lines would otherwise bisect the whole stacked
   column top to bottom - hide them there. */
@media (max-width:767px){ .seam-line{display:none;} }
.process-row{position:relative;}
.process-progress{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top center;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;}
/* process-left/process-right only sit side by side at the 1200px+ 12-col
   grid (BYGGSPEC .g12 breakpoints); below that they stack, so the seam
   the progress line marks no longer exists - hide it rather than let a
   stale left-offset poke 2px past the right edge (390/768 overflow). */
@media (max-width:1199px){ .process-progress{display:none;} }

/* R3: SplitText's own mask:'lines'/'words'/'chars' option wraps each split
   unit in its own clipping span, and every heading that gets split already
   sits inside a .cell (overflow:hidden) or .footer-cell (overflow:hidden)
   — so no extra clip rule is needed on the headings themselves (adding one
   risked cutting descenders that round 2's static layout already relies
   on fitting without it). */

/* spacing rhythm between section groups */
.rhythm{height:110px;}
@media (max-width:767px){ .rhythm{height:72px;} }
</style>
</head>

          <div class="process-image img-cell" data-resolve="process" style="background:var(--grey)">

      <div class="c-6 cell cell--pad0 process-right">
        <ol class="process-steps">
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Uppstart</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi börjar med ett samtal om er verksamhet samt vad ni vill att sidan ska göra för er. Utifrån det skapar vi ett initialt underlag som ni rättar innan det går till ritbordet.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Planering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi ritar strukturen som en skiss innan vi formger något. Där ser ni vilka sidor som behövs och vad varje sida ska få besökaren att göra, mobilen först.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Design</h3>
              <p class="process-p">När strukturen står formger vi sidan efter er verksamhet. Förslaget lägger vi på en testadress, där ni ser det på er egen telefon och säger till innan det går till bygge.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Utveckling</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi bygger sidan i kod från grunden, utan färdig mall, så att den laddar snabbt. Texter och bilder ändrar ni själva, och vill ni lägga till mer bygger ni vidare på det vi lämnat.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">05</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Innehåll</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Ni behöver inte ha något färdigt. Det ni har bearbetar vi, bygger vidare på och kompletterar där något saknas. Texten skriver vi åt er, om ni inte vill ha er egen.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">06</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Lansering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Innan sidan publiceras går vi igenom varje länk, formulär och bild. Vi testar den med tangentbord och skärmläsare, på telefon och på dator, och visar er hur ni ändrar innehållet själva.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">07</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Förvaltning</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi finns kvar efter lansering. Nya sidor och ändringar går samma väg som bygget, så ni ser dem på testadressen innan era kunder gör det. Har ni en fråga mejlar ni oss på kontakt@alunix.se.</p></div>

  <!-- ============================================================ SHOWCASE (B2): den valda casen, pinnad -->

    <!-- R3 §1 (F-021): egen pin-spacer i markupen i stället för att låta

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText);

  /* ============================================================ §0 motorn
     Lenis <-> GSAP wiring per lenis-skillen, ordagrant: autoRaf:false,
     gsap.ticker som enda RAF-drivare, lagSmoothing(0), scroll -> ST.update.
     respectReducedMotion:false: rörelse spelar alltid (F-011, spec §0). ----- */
  /* R3 §2 (F-020): husets tempo - lerp:0.075, wheelMultiplier:0.6, det
     enda utjämningslagret (scroll/devices.md § Load-bearing rules). */
  var lenis = new Lenis({ autoRaf: false, anchors: true, respectReducedMotion: false, lerp: 0.075, wheelMultiplier: 0.6 });
  window.__lenis = lenis; /* dev hook: lets §10's jump-test drive lenis.scrollTo(...,{immediate:true}) */
  gsap.ticker.add(function(time){ lenis.raf(time * 1000); });
  gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(500, 33); /* a stalled frame (>500 ms) counts as 33 ms: the scroll pauses and resumes instead of jumping to catch up (lead 2026-09-25) */
  lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);

  /* R5 fix: a ScrollTrigger.refresh() that lands WHILE the calyx showcase
     iframe is still navigating (its 'load' hasn't fired yet - a live
     same-origin document loading INSIDE an already-pinned element) reliably
     threw "insertBefore ... no longer a child" from ScrollTrigger's own
     pin-revert step, reproduced by bisecting away pin/scrub/onRefresh/the
     iframe itself one at a time until only "pin + a loading iframe inside
     it" remained. fonts.ready and the two setTimeout sweeps below can land
     in that same early window (R3: the per-image load listener that used to
     sit here is gone, see the note by §0's img-refresh removal), so every
     refresh() in the file is routed through this one gate: it
     queues (never drops) until the showcase iframe has fully settled, then
     also coalesces same-frame calls into one trailing refresh(). */
  var __showcaseIframeSettled = false;
  var __refreshTimer = null;
  function safeRefresh(){
    if (!__showcaseIframeSettled){
      if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
      __refreshTimer = setTimeout(safeRefresh, 60);
      return;
    }
    if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
    __refreshTimer = setTimeout(function(){ __refreshTimer = null; ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 200);
  }

  /* ----- lazy iframe mount, same sweep principle as V3e, now driven by the
     Lenis scroll event instead of a native scroll listener so it keeps
     firing during smoothed scroll, on anchors, and on a straight jump. ----- */
  var frames = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('iframe[data-src]'));
  var AHEAD = 2;
  var defer = window.requestIdleCallback
    ? function(fn){ requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: 600 }); }
    : function(fn){ setTimeout(fn, 1); };
  function mountFrame(f){
    var src = f.getAttribute('data-src');
    if (!src) return;
    /* R3 §1 (F-021): en iframes load anropar aldrig refresh() längre - en
       refresh mitt i en pinnad iframes navigation var grundorsaken till
       omladdningsloopen. measureCase (om iframen har en) körs fortfarande
       från sin egen load-lyssnare, orörd nedan. */
    f.src = src;
    f.removeAttribute('data-src');
  }
  function mountDue(){
    if (!frames.length) return;
    var edge = window.innerHeight * AHEAD;
    for (var i = frames.length - 1; i >= 0; i--){
      if (frames[i].getBoundingClientRect().top < edge){
        (function(f){ defer(function(){ mountFrame(f); }); })(frames[i]);
        frames.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  lenis.on('scroll', mountDue);
  addEventListener('load', mountDue);
  mountDue();

  /* ----- refresh trigger: fonts only. R3 §1 (F-021): every <img> on this
     page is either position:absolute;inset:0 (a fill layer inside an
     already-sized cell) or carries explicit width/height, so a load event
     can never change page geometry - the per-image refresh-on-load listener
     this used to have only fired ScrollTrigger.refresh() calls during the
     scroll pass as lazy images entered view (measured: 4 refreshes/pass),
     with nothing to actually remeasure. Removed; fonts.ready still refreshes
     once, since a webfont swap DOES change measured line/text geometry. ----- */
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready){
    document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ safeRefresh(); }).catch(function(){});
  }

  var isNarrow = window.innerWidth < 768;

  /* ============================================================ §3 dither -> färg
     GSAP grid-stagger (cyphr-studio lån, byggspec §1): each image cell
     gets a tile grid of <span>s cut from the dither image, layered over
     the now fully-visible colour layer. Tiles fade out on a random-order
     schedule scrubbed to the cell's own scroll range, so the resolve reads
     as pixels dissolving away, reversible on scroll-back. Hero cells
     (data-resolve="stay") keep their flat dither look and are excluded,
     per spec §3 ("alla bildceller utom heron"). ----- */
  function buildTileGrid(cell, rows, cols){
    var dither = cell.querySelector('.dither-layer');
    var color = cell.querySelector('.color-layer');
    if (!dither || !color) return null;
    gsap.set(color, { clipPath: 'inset(0px 0px 0px 0px)' });
    var src = dither.getAttribute('src');
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'tile-grid';
    grid.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(' + cols + ',1fr)';
    grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(' + rows + ',1fr)';
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    var tiles = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++){
      for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++){
        var t = document.createElement('span');
        t.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + src + ')';
        t.style.backgroundSize = (cols * 100) + '% ' + (rows * 100) + '%';
        t.style.backgroundPosition = (cols < 2 ? 0 : (c / (cols - 1) * 100)) + '% ' + (rows < 2 ? 0 : (r / (rows - 1) * 100)) + '%';
        frag.appendChild(t);
        tiles.push(t);
      }
    }
    grid.appendChild(frag);
    cell.appendChild(grid);
    dither.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    return tiles;
  }

  var resolveCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.img-cell[data-resolve]'));
  var tileDims = isNarrow ? [6, 6] : [12, 8];
  resolveCells.forEach(function(cell){
    if (cell.getAttribute('data-resolve') === 'stay') return;
    var tiles = buildTileGrid(cell, tileDims[0], tileDims[1]);
    if (!tiles) return;
    gsap.to(tiles, {
      opacity: 0,
      stagger: { grid: tileDims, from: 'random', amount: 0.9 },
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: cell, start: 'top 85%', end: 'center 55%',
        scrub: true, invalidateOnRefresh: true
      }
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================ small helper:
     a colour-matched fill that reveals from an element's left seam via
     clip-path, standing in for "cellens bakgrund fylls från sin skarv"
     wherever the spec asks for it (§4 tes-lines, §7 case heads). Keeps the
     original text above it (z-index) so nothing is ever covered. ----- */
  function seamFill(cell, fromClip){
    var cs = getComputedStyle(cell);
    var bg = cs.backgroundColor;
    if (!bg || bg === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') return null;
    var fill = document.createElement('div');
    fill.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    fill.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:' + bg + ';clip-path:' + (fromClip || 'inset(0 100% 0 0)') + ';';
    if (getComputedStyle(cell).position === 'static') cell.style.position = 'relative';
    cell.insertBefore(fill, cell.firstChild);
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(cell.children, function(child){
      if (child === fill) return;
      if (getComputedStyle(child).position === 'static') child.style.position = 'relative';
      child.style.zIndex = child.style.zIndex || '1';
    });
    cell.style.background = 'transparent';
    return fill;
  }

  /* R4 fix: SplitText's mask:'…' wrapper clips to a tight box, and the
     headlines here run at line-height:.8-1 - tight enough that a
     descender (g, y, p) gets sliced by that box's own bottom edge. Give
     every mask wrapper a hair of bottom breathing room via padding+
     matching negative margin, so the box grows without shifting layout
     (the negative margin cancels the padding's added height). ----- */
  function maskBreathe(instance){
    if (!instance || !instance.masks) return;
    instance.masks.forEach(function(m){
      m.style.paddingBottom = '0.16em';
      m.style.marginBottom = '-0.16em';
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================ §1 laddning
     · heron sätts ihop (once, <=1.4s). Cellerna öppnas med clip-path FRÅN
     sin skarv (det inre hörnet mot korsningen), inte från kanten: fjärde
     cellen (NH) sist, i diagonal ordning ÖV -> ÖH+NV -> NH. ----- */
  var heroStageEl = document.querySelector('.hero-stage');
  var HERO_SEAMS = [
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-ov'), from: 'inset(100% 0% 0% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-oh'), from: 'inset(100% 100% 0% 0%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nv'), from: 'inset(0% 0% 100% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nh'), from: 'inset(0% 100% 100% 0%)' }
  ];
  HERO_SEAMS.forEach(function(s){ if (s.el) gsap.set(s.el, { clipPath: s.from }); });

  var seamV = document.createElement('div');
  seamV.className = 'seam-line';

       tak - ren aritmetik, rör aldrig C.w. */
    var max = d.documentElement.scrollHeight - ih - 20;
    if (!ih || max <= 0) return false;
    C.w = w;
    C.y = C.anchors.map(function(a){
      var el = a[0] === 'top' ? null : d.querySelector(a[0]);
      var t = el ? el.offsetTop : 0;
      var off = a[1] === 'center' ? (el ? (el.offsetHeight - ih) / 2 : 0) : a[1] * ih;
      if (a[2] && ih < (a[3] || Infinity)) off += a[2];
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(max, Math.round(t + off)));
    });
    return true;
  }
  /* R7 runda 2, fynd 4: den verkliga orsaken satt i measureCase() ovan (den
     beräknade `max` mot webbläsarens egen scrollTo-klamning), inte här -
     se den kommentaren. Kvar här: en ren defensiv ommätning när iframens
     egna webbtypsnitt (om sidan har några) hunnit byta in, billig och
     harmlös oavsett om den råkar sakna ett verkligt fel att fånga. */
  function measureCaseSettled(C){
    var ok = measureCase(C);
    var d = null;
    try { d = C.iframe && C.iframe.contentDocument; } catch (e) { d = null; }
    if (d && d.fonts && d.fonts.ready){
      d.fonts.ready.then(function(){ measureCase(C); });
    }
    return ok;
  }
  /* B: segment k (1..n-1) owns progress [k/n,(k+1)/n) - first half glides
     anchor k-1 -> k with sine.inOut (zero velocity both ends, no jerk),
     second half dwells on anchor k in the reading window. Segment 0 is rest
     on anchor 0. n = C.y.length (each case's own anchor count) - the PIN's
     total pixel length is fixed regardless of n (see setupDesktopEngine),
     this only divides that fixed [0,1] progress range into the case's own
     stops. */
  /* R3 §3 (F-020): sajten glider under de FÖRSTA 70% av segmentet (var 50%)
     och står still resten - mjukare, längre glid innan läsfönstret. */
  var SITE_GLIDE_FRAC = 0.7;
  function caseY(C, p){
    var n = C.y.length, pp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)), kf = pp * n;
    var k = Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(kf)), t = kf - k;
    if (k === 0) return C.y[0];
    var half = Math.min(1, t / SITE_GLIDE_FRAC);
    var u = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * half); /* sine.inOut */
    return C.y[k - 1] + (C.y[k] - C.y[k - 1]) * u;
  }
  function writeCaseScroll(C, p){
    if (!C.y || !C.w) return;
    var y = caseY(C, p);
    if (Math.abs(y - C.last) >= 0.5){
      C.w.scrollTo({ top: y, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
      C.last = y;
    }
  }

  /* C: the active step index, from the SAME progress caseY reads, gated to
     the crossfade's own 25%/25% timing so the outgoing step is still
     flagged active while it fades and the incoming one only takes over
     once its own fade-in starts (SHOWCASE-SPEC §C: "tonas ut i första 25%",
     "tonas in i nästa 25%"). */
  /* R3 §3 (F-020): texten tonas över under de FÖRSTA 30% av segmentet
     (ut 0-15%, in 15-30%), var 50% (25%/25%) - kortare övertoning, längre
     still-stående läsfönster. */
  var STEP_OUT_FRAC = 0.15, STEP_IN_FRAC = 0.15;
  function activeStepIndexFor(n, p){
    var pp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)), kf = pp * n;
    var k = Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(kf));
    if (k === 0) return 0;
    var t = kf - k;
    return t < STEP_OUT_FRAC ? k - 1 : k;
  }
  function pad2(n){ return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }

  /* desktop only: toggles aria-hidden/visibility once per step change (not
     per frame, per spec) and updates the mono counter. The crossfade itself
     is C.tl (built in buildStepTimelines), scrubbed by the same pin. */
  function setStepState(C, p){
    var n = C.anchors.length;
    var idx = activeStepIndexFor(n, p);
    if (C.lastStep === idx) return;
    C.lastStep = idx;
    C.steps.forEach(function(row, i){
      var active = i === idx;
      row.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      row.setAttribute('aria-hidden', active ? 'false' : 'true');
      row.style.visibility = active ? '' : 'hidden';
    });
    if (C.counter) C.counter.textContent = pad2(idx + 1) + ' / ' + pad2(n);
  }

  function writeTrackFill(p){
    var pp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
    Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(k){
      var fill = CASES[k].trackFill;
      if (fill) fill.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + pp + ')';
    });
  }

  function updateShowcase(C, p){
    writeCaseScroll(C, p);
    if (C.tl) C.tl.progress(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)));
    setStepState(C, p);
  }

  /* C: one GSAP timeline per case, paused, progress-driven (never played) -
     0..1 on the timeline maps 1:1 to the pin's own progress. Each step k
     (1..n-1) fades out step k-1 (opacity 1->0, y 0->-12px) over the
     segment's first 25%, then fades in step k (opacity 0->1, y 12->0) over
     the next 25%; the remaining 50% (the segment's dwell half, matching B)
     is untouched, so the step reads fully still for >=40vh. Only opacity
     and transform animate. */
  function buildStepTimelines(){
    Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(key){
      var C = CASES[key];
      var box = C.el.querySelector('.showcase-rows');
      C.head = C.el.querySelector('.showcase-head');
      C.box = box;
      C.counter = box.querySelector('.showcase-counter');
      C.trackFill = box.querySelector('.showcase-track-fill');
      C.steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('.showcase-row'));
      C.textEls = C.steps.map(function(row){ return row.querySelector('.showcase-row-text'); });
      var n = C.anchors.length;
      gsap.set(C.textEls, { opacity: 0, y: 12 });
      gsap.set(C.textEls[0], { opacity: 1, y: 0 });
      C.steps.forEach(function(row, i){
        row.classList.toggle('is-active', i === 0);
        row.setAttribute('aria-hidden', i === 0 ? 'false' : 'true');
        row.style.visibility = i === 0 ? '' : 'hidden';
      });
      C.lastStep = 0;
      /* R6 runda 6 (F-022): detaljcellen - en figur per steg, samma dither->
         färg-rutnät som #kontakt/tes-bilden (buildTileGrid, ingen ny variant).
         Rutnätet byggs en gång här (aldrig i klickvägen) och dess tiles
         tonas i den här casens egen C.tl nedan, i samma skrubbade tidslinje
         som texten - aldrig en egen scrollTrigger (det vore resolveCells
         generiska mekanism, avsedd för fristående bildceller, inte för
         steg som redan drivs av pinnens progress). 8x5 - ungefär kvadratiska
         rutor mot detaljcellens liggande proportion. */
      var TILE_COLS = 8, TILE_ROWS = 5;
      C.detail = box.querySelector('.showcase-detail');
      C.figures = C.detail ? Array.prototype.slice.call(C.detail.querySelectorAll('.showcase-figure')) : [];
      C.figureTiles = C.figures.map(function(fig){ return buildTileGrid(fig, TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS); });
      gsap.set(C.figures, { opacity: 0 });
      if (C.figures[0]) gsap.set(C.figures[0], { opacity: 1 });
      var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      for (var k = 1; k < n; k++){
        var segStart = k / n, outDur = STEP_OUT_FRAC / n, inDur = STEP_IN_FRAC / n;
        tl.to(C.textEls[k - 1], { opacity: 0, y: -12, duration: outDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart);
        tl.to(C.textEls[k], { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: inDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart + outDur);
        /* figuren tonas i/ur med samma position/duration som texten - "en
           mekanism", ingen separat timing för bilden. */
        if (C.figures[k - 1]) tl.to(C.figures[k - 1], { opacity: 0, duration: outDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart);
        if (C.figures[k]) tl.to(C.figures[k], { opacity: 1, duration: inDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart + outDur);
      }
      /* dither->färg-upplösningen: under stegets eget vilofönster, efter att
         intoningen hunnit klart (0.35/n) och med marginal innan nästa stegs
         uttoning (klar 0.85/n) - steg 0 saknar en intoning att vänta in, så
         dess fönster börjar redan vid 0.1/n. */
      C.figures.forEach(function(fig, i){
        var tiles = C.figureTiles[i];
        if (!tiles || !tiles.length) return;
        var segStart0 = i / n;
        var restStart = segStart0 + (i === 0 ? 0.1 : 0.35) / n;
        var restEnd = segStart0 + 0.85 / n;
        var win = Math.max(0.05 / n, restEnd - restStart);
        tl.to(tiles, {
          opacity: 0,
          duration: win * 0.4,
          stagger: { grid: [TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS], from: 'random', amount: win * 0.6 }
        }, restStart);
      });
      /* lead 2026-09-25: pad to exactly 1. The tweens sit at absolute
         positions on a 0-1 scale, but the last one ends near 0.86, so the
         timeline was shorter than 1 and tl.progress(p) ran the text out of
         step with the counter and the site - late steps never faded in, and
         scrolling back left the active step at opacity 0. */
      tl.set({}, {}, 1);
      C.tl = tl;
    });
  }

  /* A: the pin is created ONCE here, at init, and never killed/recreated -
     a click only swaps which C activeCaseKey points at (grundorsak 1).
     The pin's own length is FIXED (6 segments x 75vh) regardless of which
     case is active or how many anchors it has, so a casebyte never needs a
     geometry-changing refresh() (grundorsak 6); Calyx's 5 anchors simply
     divide that same fixed length into 5 stops instead of 6 (see caseY). */
  function setupDesktopEngine(){
    measureCaseSettled(CASES.calyx);
    measureCaseSettled(CASES.horai);
    scaleShowcaseFrame();
    buildStepTimelines();
    showcaseST = ScrollTrigger.create({
      /* R7 runda 2, fynd 1: 'top top+=48' pins the section 48px below the
         viewport's own top, exactly under the sticky topline, instead of
         at y:0 under it - see the CSS comment above .showcase-embed-cell
         for why 100svh alone (matching hero's own pin) let the topline
         cover .showcase-head's rubrik. */
      trigger: '#showcase', start: 'top top+=48',
      /* R3 §3 (F-020): 6 segment x 110vh (var 75vh) - showcasen glider
         långsammare mellan texterna. */
      end: function(){ return '+=' + Math.round(6 * 1.1 * window.innerHeight); },
      invalidateOnRefresh: true,
      /* R3 §1 (F-021): pinSpacer pekar på markupens egen '.showcase-pin-
         spacer' i stället för att ScrollTrigger skapar/flyttar en egen vid
         varje refresh() - den flytten omparenterade de pinnade iframarna
         och laddade om dem. */
      pin: '.showcase-stage', pinSpacer: '.showcase-pin-spacer', pinSpacing: true, scrub: true,
      onUpdate: function(self){ updateShowcase(CASES[activeCaseKey], self.progress); writeTrackFill(self.progress); },
      onRefresh: function(self){ updateShowcase(CASES[activeCaseKey], self.progress); writeTrackFill(self.progress); }
    });
    updateShowcase(CASES[activeCaseKey], 0);
  }

  function setMobileRowOpacity(textEls, activeIndex){
    textEls.forEach(function(el, i){
      if (!el) return;
      gsap.to(el, { opacity: i === activeIndex ? 1 : MOBILE_INACTIVE_OPACITY, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out', overwrite: 'auto' });
    });
  }

  /* declared here (not next to buildMobileRowTriggers below) so it exists
     before gsap.matchMedia().add() runs its mobile branch synchronously on
     registration - a `var` later in the file is hoisted as a declaration
     but stays undefined until its own assignment line actually executes,
     and that line ran too late, throwing on the very first page load. */
  var mobileTriggers = [];

  /* R4 §1: ease-in-out-cubic (var 1-2^(-10t), som la nästan hela rörelsen i
     de första bildrutorna) - t.ex. den mätta 629px-toppen. Samma kurva,
     duration 1.8 (var 1.4). */
  function easeInOutCubic(t){ return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2; }

  function activateCase(key, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    var isNewSelection = key !== activeCaseKey;
    var prevKey = activeCaseKey;
    activeCaseKey = key;
    caseChoices.forEach(function(btn){ btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', btn.getAttribute('data-case') === key ? 'true' : 'false'); });

    /* R5: klicket skriver bara opacity/visibility och byter activeCaseKey -
       inga layoutläsningar. CDP-tracing runt klicket (RAPPORT.md R5) mätte
       de tre största posterna i den gamla 470-536 ms-bildrutan: Layout
       ~154-164 ms (Hōrais dokument, tvingat av measureCase), Script ~226 ms
       (gsap.min.js, värdet för den tvingade layoutläsningen), Decode
       ~213-216 ms (Hōrais egna foton, avkodade första gången). Grundorsaken
       var att Hōrais iframe stod display:none och blev utlagd, målad OCH
       avkodad första gången mitt i klicket. R4:s fix (skriv/läs i olika
       bildrutor) höll inte - en hel sidas foton hinner inte avkodas på en
       enda bildrutas marginal. R5:s fix: förladdningen (se load-lyssnaren
       nedan) lägger ut, målar OCH mäter BÅDA iframes i bakgrunden, långt
       innan något klick - klicket har därför inget kvar att tvinga fram. */
    if (opts.scroll !== false && lenis && lenis.scrollTo){
      lenis.scrollTo('#showcase', { duration: 1.8, easing: easeInOutCubic });
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      var C = CASES[key], prevC = CASES[prevKey];

      if (isNewSelection){
        /* A#2: panel and iframe crossfade - old out 0.3s, new in 0.35s,
           power2.out, interruptible (overwrite:'auto'). visibility:visible
           är permanent efter förvärmningen (R5, se prewarmInactiveCase) -
           bara opacity skiljer aktiv från inaktiv iframe, som Calyx alltid
           gjort. Panelen behåller display:none (mätt: dess egen växling
           kostar ingen layout, se RAPPORT.md R5 §2b). */
        C.el.style.display = '';
        C.el.toggleAttribute('inert', false);
        C.iframe.style.visibility = 'visible';
        if (C.head && C.box) gsap.set([C.head, C.box], { opacity: 0 });
        var tl = gsap.timeline({ overwrite: 'auto' });
        tl.to(prevC.iframe, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        if (prevC.head && prevC.box) tl.to([prevC.head, prevC.box], { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        tl.to(C.iframe, { opacity: C.loaded ? 1 : 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        if (C.head && C.box) tl.to([C.head, C.box], { opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        tl.add(function(){
          prevC.el.style.display = 'none';
          prevC.el.toggleAttribute('inert', true);
        }, 0.3);
      }

      /* R5: measureCaseSettled är borta härifrån - den kördes redan vid
         förladdningens load/fonts.ready/resize (se nedan), inte vid klick. */
      if (window.innerWidth >= 768){
        /* A#5: no ScrollTrigger.refresh() from the click. C changes and
           updateShowcase reads the pin's CURRENT progress, never resets to 0. */
        if (isNewSelection && showcaseST) updateShowcase(C, showcaseST.progress);
        scaleShowcaseFrame();
      } else if (isNewSelection){
        buildMobileRowTriggers(C);
        if (C.mobileTextEls) setMobileRowOpacity(C.mobileTextEls, 0);
      }
    });
  }

  caseChoices.forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ activateCase(btn.getAttribute('data-case')); });
  });

  gsap.matchMedia().add({ isDesktop: '(min-width:768px)', isMobile: '(max-width:767px)' }, function(context){
    if (context.conditions.isDesktop){
      setupDesktopEngine();
      return function(){
        if (showcaseST){ showcaseST.kill(); showcaseST = null; }
        Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(k){ if (CASES[k].tl) CASES[k].tl.kill(); });
      };
    }
    /* mobile (§C): no pin - the frame sits position:sticky (CSS) while
       rows scroll under it; each row's onEnter/onEnterBack tweens the
       site's own inner scroll to that row's anchor over 0.6s, and
       crossfades the active row's text to opacity 1 / the rest to
       MOBILE_INACTIVE_OPACITY over 0.35s (measured contrast fix, see the
       constant's own comment). R5 bugfix (kept): scaleShowcaseFrame() was
       only ever called from setupDesktopEngine() (the isDesktop branch) -
       on mobile the iframe kept its native 1440x900 box with no scale
       transform at all, so the sticky cell showed an unscaled, cropped
       sliver of the top-left corner instead of the whole page shrunk to fit.

       R7 runda 2, fynd 2 (tredje bugfixen): building triggers for BOTH
       cases' rows here, unconditionally, used to fire onEnter for the
       inactive case's rows immediately at creation - its panel is
       display:none at that point, so getBoundingClientRect() on every one
       of its rows reads {top:0, bottom:0}, which already satisfies
       `start:'top 70%'` the instant ScrollTrigger checks it. Measured
       (page.evaluate, straight after page load, no click/scroll yet):
       CASES.horai.pendingRow was already 5 (the LAST row) before a single
       real scroll happened - all six onEnter calls had already misfired.
       ScrollTrigger then treats that forward crossing as spent and never
       re-fires it on a real scroll in the same direction, so the case
       stayed frozen at whatever that init-time misfire last touched.
       Building only the CURRENTLY VISIBLE case's row triggers - and
       rebuilding them in activateCase() the moment a case becomes visible,
       when its rows have real, live positions - is what actually fixes it. */
    buildMobileRowTriggers(CASES[activeCaseKey]);
    return function(){ mobileTriggers.forEach(function(t){ t.kill(); }); mobileTriggers = []; };
  });

  function buildMobileRowTriggers(C){
    mobileTriggers.forEach(function(t){ t.kill(); });
    mobileTriggers = [];
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(C.el.querySelectorAll('.showcase-row'));
    var textEls = rows.map(function(row){ return row.querySelector('.showcase-row-text'); });
    C.mobileTextEls = textEls;
    gsap.set(textEls, { opacity: MOBILE_INACTIVE_OPACITY });
    gsap.set(textEls[0], { opacity: 1 });
    rows.forEach(function(row, i){
      mobileTriggers.push(ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: row, start: 'top 70%',
        onEnter: function(){ tweenCaseTo(C, i); setMobileRowOpacity(textEls, i); },
        onEnterBack: function(){ tweenCaseTo(C, i); setMobileRowOpacity(textEls, i); }
      }));
    });
  }

  function tweenCaseTo(C, i){
    /* R7 runda 2, fynd 2: remember which row was actually wanted even when
       the measurement below fails (iframe not yet loaded) - the 'load'
       listener reads this to catch the embedded site up to the right row
       the instant it finally can, instead of leaving it frozen at row 0. */
    C.pendingRow = i;
    if (!C.y && !measureCaseSettled(C)) return;
    var target = C.y[i];
    /* R7 runda 2, fynd 2 (andra bugfixen): startade tidigare från C.last,
       som börjar på sentinelvärdet -1. Första någonsin-anropet för en case
       fick då proxy.v = target redan vid skapandet (C.last<0) - en tween
       FRÅN target TILL target. Uppmätt (page.evaluate, en isolerad körning):
       C.last stod kvar på -1 genom alla sex radbyten, vilket bevisar att
       onUpdate aldrig hann skriva ett enda värde innan nästa rad already
       återskapade samma självrefererande nollrörelse - självförstärkande,
       aldrig läkt av sig själv. Att läsa iframens EGEN levande scrollY i
       stället för den cachade C.last är alltid sant (0 vid första anropet,
       vad den faktiskt står i därefter) och kan aldrig fastna i samma fälla. */
    var proxy = { v: C.w ? C.w.scrollY : target };
    gsap.to(proxy, {
      v: target, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: function(){
        if (C.w && Math.abs(proxy.v - C.last) >= 0.5){ C.w.scrollTo({ top: proxy.v, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' }); C.last = proxy.v; }
      }
    });
  }

  addEventListener('resize', function(){
    scaleShowcaseFrame();
    Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(k){
      var C = CASES[k];
      if (C.w) measureCase(C);
    });
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ============================================================ §7b calyx / hōrai showcase copy (was §7) */
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.showcase-head'), function(head){
    var h2 = head.querySelector('h2');
    var fill = seamFill(head, 'inset(0 100% 0 0)');
    if (fill){
      gsap.to(fill, {
        clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0)', duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: head, start: 'top 75%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
      });
    }
    if (h2){
      var nameSplit = SplitText.create(h2, { type: 'chars', mask: 'chars', aria: 'auto' });
      maskBreathe(nameSplit);
      gsap.set(nameSplit.chars, { yPercent: 100 });
      gsap.to(nameSplit.chars, {
        yPercent: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power4.out', stagger: 0.03,
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: head, start: 'top 75%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
      });
    }
  });

  /* ============================================================ §8 priset */
  var prisLead = document.querySelector('.pris-lead');
  var prisA = document.querySelector('.pris-tier-a');
  var prisB = document.querySelector('.pris-tier-b');
  var prisTl = gsap.timeline({
    defaults: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out' },
    scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.pris-bento', start: 'top 78%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }
  });
  if (prisLead) prisTl.fromTo(prisLead, { xPercent: -14, autoAlpha: 0 }, { xPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1 }, 0);
  if (prisA) prisTl.fromTo(prisA, { yPercent: -18, autoAlpha: 0 }, { yPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1 }, 0.08);
  if (prisB) prisTl.fromTo(prisB, { yPercent: 18, autoAlpha: 0 }, { yPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1 }, 0.16);

  function countUp(el, targetNumber, originalText){
    var proxy = { v: 0 };
    gsap.to(proxy, {
      v: targetNumber, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power2.out',
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%', once: true },
      onUpdate: function(){
        var whole = Math.round(proxy.v).toString();
        var grouped = whole.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ');
        el.childNodes[0].nodeValue = grouped + ' ';
      },
      onComplete: function(){ el.childNodes[0].nodeValue = originalText; }
    });
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.price-value.tnum'), function(el){
    var text = el.childNodes[0] && el.childNodes[0].nodeValue ? el.childNodes[0].nodeValue : '';
    var digits = text.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return;
    countUp(el, parseInt(digits, 10), text);
  });

  /* ============================================================ §9 R5: kontakt · kortet lämnas över (C) */
  var kontaktAnchor = document.getElementById('kontaktCardAnchor');
  var kontaktTilt = document.getElementById('kontaktCardTilt');
  var kontaktFlip = document.getElementById('kontaktCardFlip');
  var kontaktFront = document.getElementById('kontaktCardFront');
  var kontaktBack = document.getElementById('kontaktCardBack');
  var kontaktBackHit = document.getElementById('kontaktCardBackHit');
  var kontaktFlipped = false;

  if (kontaktFlip){
    gsap.set(kontaktFlip, { rotationY: 0, transformPerspective: 1200 });
    gsap.set(kontaktTilt, { transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' });

    function setKontaktFlip(flipped, opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      if (flipped === kontaktFlipped) return;

ALUNIX
kontakt@alunix.se
Er hemsida är nutidens visitkort
Alunix. Digital byrå. Design, utveckling, system. Boka ett möte: kontakt@alunix.se.
Alunix
Digital byrå
Design
Utveckling
System
Boka ett möte
Det första intrycket är digitalt.
Skärmen möter besökaren före texten.
Innan ett ord är läst bär layout och bild hela argumentet.
Vi hjälper er att synas på rätt sätt.
Vår process:
Från samtal till lanserad sida.
Webbdesign, design och system. Allt på ett ställe.
Uppstart
Vi börjar med ett samtal om er verksamhet samt vad ni vill att sidan ska göra för er. Utifrån det skapar vi ett initialt underlag som ni rättar innan det går till ritbordet.
Planering
Vi ritar strukturen som en skiss innan vi formger något. Där ser ni vilka sidor som behövs och vad varje sida ska få besökaren att göra, mobilen först.
När strukturen står formger vi sidan efter er verksamhet. Förslaget lägger vi på en testadress, där ni ser det på er egen telefon och säger till innan det går till bygge.
Vi bygger sidan i kod från grunden, utan färdig mall, så att den laddar snabbt. Texter och bilder ändrar ni själva, och vill ni lägga till mer bygger ni vidare på det vi lämnat.
Innehåll
Ni behöver inte ha något färdigt. Det ni har bearbetar vi, bygger vidare på och kompletterar där något saknas. Texten skriver vi åt er, om ni inte vill ha er egen.
Lansering
Innan sidan publiceras går vi igenom varje länk, formulär och bild. Vi testar den med tangentbord och skärmläsare, på telefon och på dator, och visar er hur ni ändrar innehållet själva.
Förvaltning
Vi finns kvar efter lansering. Nya sidor och ändringar går samma väg som bygget, så ni ser dem på testadressen innan era kunder gör det. Har ni en fråga mejlar ni oss på kontakt@alunix.se.
Exempelcase
Calyx
Florist, Stockholm
Hōrai
Restaurang, Asian Fusion
01 / 05
Fotot får göra jobbet
Vi lade rubriken direkt på fotot och satte utgåvans nummer i hörnet, som på ett magasin. En bukett säljer på hur den ser ut, så fotot fick nästan hela första skärmen.
En serif, inget mer
Rubriker och brödtext går i samma serif, och kursiven sköter betoningen. Ett andra rubriktypsnitt hade dragit åt reklam. Bara etiketterna fick ett eget, skrivmaskinslikt typsnitt.
Bilderna kommer i par
Vi satte fotona parvis och gav varje bild en märkning med uppdragets nummer och adress. Då läses de som beställningar ateljén har levererat.
Utbudet som prislista
Veckans utbud blev en lista med löpnummer, namn och pris i högerkant. Ett rutnät med kort hade krävt nytt foto varje vecka. Med en lista räcker det att skriva om en rad.
Ett mejl räcker
Där ett formulär brukar stå satte vi en e-postadress. Besökaren skriver om rummet och ljuset med egna ord, och ateljén svarar med vad som finns den veckan.

Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\Anton L\.claude\skills\copywriting

# Copywriting

You are an expert conversion copywriter. Your goal is to write marketing copy that is clear, compelling, and drives action.

## Before Writing

**Check for product marketing context first:**
If `.agents/product-marketing.md` exists (or `.claude/product-marketing.md`, or the legacy `product-marketing-context.md` filename, in older setups), read it before asking questions. Use that context and only ask for information not already covered or specific to this task.

Gather this context (ask if not provided):

### 1. Page Purpose
- What type of page? (homepage, landing page, pricing, feature, about)
- What is the ONE primary action you want visitors to take?

### 2. Audience
- Who is the ideal customer?
- What problem are they trying to solve?
- What objections or hesitations do they have?
- What language do they use to describe their problem?

### 3. Product/Offer
- What are you selling or offering?
- What makes it different from alternatives?
- What's the key transformation or outcome?
- Any proof points (numbers, testimonials, case studies)?

### 4. Context
- Where is traffic coming from? (ads, organic, email)
- What do visitors already know before arriving?

---

## Copywriting Principles

### Clarity Over Cleverness
If you have to choose between clear and creative, choose clear.

### Benefits Over Features
Features: What it does. Benefits: What that means for the customer.

### Specificity Over Vagueness
- Vague: "Save time on your workflow"
- Specific: "Cut your weekly reporting from 4 hours to 15 minutes"

### Customer Language Over Company Language
Use words your customers use. Mirror voice-of-customer from reviews, interviews, support tickets.

### One Idea Per Section
Each section should advance one argument. Build a logical flow down the page.

---

## Writing Style Rules

### Core Principles

1. **Simple over complex** — "Use" not "utilize," "help" not "facilitate"
2. **Specific over vague** — Avoid "streamline," "optimize," "innovative"
3. **Active over passive** — "We generate reports" not "Reports are generated"
4. **Confident over qualified** — Remove "almost," "very," "really"
5. **Show over tell** — Describe the outcome instead of using adverbs
6. **Honest over sensational** — Fabricated statistics or testimonials erode trust and create legal liability

### Quick Quality Check

- Jargon that could confuse outsiders?
- Sentences trying to do too much?
- Passive voice constructions?
- Exclamation points? (remove them)
- Marketing buzzwords without substance?

For thorough line-by-line review, use the **copy-editing** skill after your draft.

---

## Best Practices

### Be Direct
Get to the point. Don't bury the value in qualifications.

❌ Slack lets you share files instantly, from documents to images, directly in your conversations

✅ Need to share a screenshot? Send as many documents, images, and audio files as your heart desires.

### Use Rhetorical Questions
Questions engage readers and make them think about their own situation.
- "Hate returning stuff to Amazon?"
- "Tired of chasing approvals?"

### Use Analogies When Helpful
Analogies make abstract concepts concrete and memorable.

### Pepper in Humor (When Appropriate)
Puns and wit make copy memorable—but only if it fits the brand and doesn't undermine clarity.

---

## Page Structure Framework

### Above the Fold

**Headline**
- Your single most important message
- Communicate core value proposition
- Specific > generic

**Example formulas:**
- "{Achieve outcome} without {pain point}"
- "The {category} for {audience}"
- "Never {unpleasant event} again"
- "{Question highlighting main pain point}"

**For comprehensive headline formulas**: See [references/copy-frameworks.md](references/copy-frameworks.md)

**For natural transition phrases**: See [references/natural-transitions.md](references/natural-transitions.md)

**Subheadline**
- Expands on headline
- Adds specificity
- 1-2 sentences max

**Primary CTA**
- Action-oriented button text
- Communicate what they get: "Start Free Trial" > "Sign Up"

### Core Sections

| Section | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| Social Proof | Build credibility (logos, stats, testimonials) |
| Problem/Pain | Show you understand their situation |
| Solution/Benefits | Connect to outcomes (3-5 key benefits) |
| How It Works | Reduce perceived complexity (3-4 steps) |
| Objection Handling | FAQ, comparisons, guarantees |
| Final CTA | Recap value, repeat CTA, risk reversal |

**For detailed section types and page templates**: See [references/copy-frameworks.md](references/copy-frameworks.md)

---

## CTA Copy Guidelines

**Weak CTAs (avoid):**
- Submit, Sign Up, Learn More, Click Here, Get Started

**Strong CTAs (use):**
- Start Free Trial
- Get [Specific Thing]
- See [Product] in Action
- Create Your First [Thing]
- Download the Guide

**Formula:** [Action Verb] + [What They Get] + [Qualifier if needed]

Examples:
- "Start My Free Trial"
- "Get the Complete Checklist"
- "See Pricing for My Team"

---

## Page-Specific Guidance

### Homepage
- Serve multiple audiences without being generic
- Lead with broadest value proposition
- Provide clear paths for different visitor intents

### Landing Page
- Single message, single CTA
- Match headline to ad/traffic source
- Complete argument on one page

### Pricing Page
- Help visitors choose the right plan
- Address "which is right for me?" anxiety
- Make recommended plan obvious

### Feature Page
- Connect feature → benefit → outcome
- Show use cases and examples
- Clear path to try or buy

### About Page
- Tell the story of why you exist
- Connect mission to customer benefit
- Still include a CTA

---

## Voice and Tone

Before writing, establish:

**Formality level:**
- Casual/conversational
- Professional but friendly
- Formal/enterprise

**Brand personality:**
- Playful or serious?
- Bold or understated?
- Technical or accessible?

Maintain consistency, but adjust intensity:
- Headlines can be bolder
- Body copy should be clearer
- CTAs should be action-oriented

---

## Output Format

When writing copy, provide:

### Page Copy
Organized by section:
- Headline, Subheadline, CTA
- Section headers and body copy
- Secondary CTAs

### Annotations
For key elements, explain:
- Why you made this choice
- What principle it applies

### Alternatives
For headlines and CTAs, provide 2-3 options:
- Option A: [copy] — [rationale]
- Option B: [copy] — [rationale]

### Meta Content (if relevant)
- Page title (for SEO)
- Meta description

---

## Related Skills

- **copy-editing**: For polishing existing copy (use after your draft)
- **cro**: If page structure/strategy needs work, not just copy
- **emails**: For email copywriting
- **popups**: For popup and modal copy
- **ab-testing**: To test copy variations

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\Anton L\.claude\skills\copy-editing

# Copy Editing

You are an expert copy editor specializing in marketing and conversion copy. Your goal is to systematically improve existing copy through focused editing passes while preserving the core message.

## Core Philosophy

**Check for product marketing context first:**
If `.agents/product-marketing.md` exists (or `.claude/product-marketing.md`, or the legacy `product-marketing-context.md` filename, in older setups), read it before editing. Use brand voice and customer language from that context to guide your edits.

Good copy editing isn't about rewriting—it's about enhancing. Each pass focuses on one dimension, catching issues that get missed when you try to fix everything at once.

**Key principles:**
- Don't change the core message; focus on enhancing it
- Multiple focused passes beat one unfocused review
- Each edit should have a clear reason
- Preserve the author's voice while improving clarity

---

## The Seven Sweeps Framework

Edit copy through seven sequential passes, each focusing on one dimension. After each sweep, loop back to check previous sweeps aren't compromised.

### Sweep 1: Clarity

**Focus:** Can the reader understand what you're saying?

**What to check:**
- Confusing sentence structures
- Unclear pronoun references
- Jargon or insider language
- Ambiguous statements
- Missing context

**Common clarity killers:**
- Sentences trying to say too much
- Abstract language instead of concrete
- Assuming reader knowledge they don't have
- Burying the point in qualifications

**Process:**
1. Read through quickly, highlighting unclear parts
2. Don't correct yet—just note problem areas
3. After marking issues, recommend specific edits
4. Verify edits maintain the original intent

**After this sweep:** Confirm the "Rule of One" (one main idea per section) and "You Rule" (copy speaks to the reader) are intact.

---

### Sweep 2: Voice and Tone

**Focus:** Is the copy consistent in how it sounds?

**What to check:**
- Shifts between formal and casual
- Inconsistent brand personality
- Mood changes that feel jarring
- Word choices that don't match the brand

**Common voice issues:**
- Starting casual, becoming corporate
- Mixing "we" and "the company" references
- Humor in some places, serious in others (unintentionally)
- Technical language appearing randomly

**Process:**
1. Read aloud to hear inconsistencies
2. Mark where tone shifts unexpectedly
3. Recommend edits that smooth transitions
4. Ensure personality remains throughout

**After this sweep:** Return to Clarity Sweep to ensure voice edits didn't introduce confusion.

---

### Sweep 3: So What

**Focus:** Does every claim answer "why should I care?"

**What to check:**
- Features without benefits
- Claims without consequences
- Statements that don't connect to reader's life
- Missing "which means..." bridges

**The So What test:**
For every statement, ask "Okay, so what?" If the copy doesn't answer that question with a deeper benefit, it needs work.

❌ "Our platform uses AI-powered analytics"
*So what?*
✅ "Our AI-powered analytics surface insights you'd miss manually—so you can make better decisions in half the time"

**Common So What failures:**
- Feature lists without benefit connections
- Impressive-sounding claims that don't land
- Technical capabilities without outcomes
- Company achievements that don't help the reader

**Process:**
1. Read each claim and literally ask "so what?"
2. Highlight claims missing the answer
3. Add the benefit bridge or deeper meaning
4. Ensure benefits connect to real reader desires

**After this sweep:** Return to Voice and Tone, then Clarity.

---

### Sweep 4: Prove It

**Focus:** Is every claim supported with evidence?

**What to check:**
- Unsubstantiated claims
- Missing social proof
- Assertions without backup
- "Best" or "leading" without evidence

**Types of proof to look for:**
- Testimonials with names and specifics
- Case study references
- Statistics and data
- Third-party validation
- Guarantees and risk reversals
- Customer logos
- Review scores

**Common proof gaps:**
- "Trusted by thousands" (which thousands?)
- "Industry-leading" (according to whom?)
- "Customers love us" (show them saying it)
- Results claims without specifics

**Process:**
1. Identify every claim that needs proof
2. Check if proof exists nearby
3. Flag unsupported assertions
4. Recommend adding proof or softening claims

**After this sweep:** Return to So What, Voice and Tone, then Clarity.

---

### Sweep 5: Specificity

**Focus:** Is the copy concrete enough to be compelling?

**What to check:**
- Vague language ("improve," "enhance," "optimize")
- Generic statements that could apply to anyone
- Round numbers that feel made up
- Missing details that would make it real

**Specificity upgrades:**

| Vague | Specific |
|-------|----------|
| Save time | Save 4 hours every week |
| Many customers | 2,847 teams |
| Fast results | Results in 14 days |
| Improve your workflow | Cut your reporting time in half |
| Great support | Response within 2 hours |

**Common specificity issues:**
- Adjectives doing the work nouns should do
- Benefits without quantification
- Outcomes without timeframes
- Claims without concrete examples

**Process:**
1. Highlight vague words and phrases
2. Ask "Can this be more specific?"
3. Add numbers, timeframes, or examples
4. Remove content that can't be made specific (it's probably filler)

**After this sweep:** Return to Prove It, So What, Voice and Tone, then Clarity.

---

### Sweep 6: Heightened Emotion

**Focus:** Does the copy make the reader feel something?

**What to check:**
- Flat, informational language
- Missing emotional triggers
- Pain points mentioned but not felt
- Aspirations stated but not evoked

**Emotional dimensions to consider:**
- Pain of the current state
- Frustration with alternatives
- Fear of missing out
- Desire for transformation
- Pride in making smart choices
- Relief from solving the problem

**Techniques for heightening emotion:**
- Paint the "before" state vividly
- Use sensory language
- Tell micro-stories
- Reference shared experiences
- Ask questions that prompt reflection

**Process:**
1. Read for emotional impact—does it move you?
2. Identify flat sections that should resonate
3. Add emotional texture while staying authentic
4. Ensure emotion serves the message (not manipulation)

**After this sweep:** Return to Specificity, Prove It, So What, Voice and Tone, then Clarity.

---

### Sweep 7: Zero Risk

**Focus:** Have we removed every barrier to action?

**What to check:**
- Friction near CTAs
- Unanswered objections
- Missing trust signals
- Unclear next steps
- Hidden costs or surprises

**Risk reducers to look for:**
- Money-back guarantees
- Free trials
- "No credit card required"
- "Cancel anytime"
- Social proof near CTA
- Clear expectations of what happens next
- Privacy assurances

**Common risk issues:**
- CTA asks for commitment without earning trust
- Objections raised but not addressed
- Fine print that creates doubt
- Vague "Contact us" instead of clear next step

**Process:**
1. Focus on sections near CTAs
2. List every reason someone might hesitate
3. Check if the copy addresses each concern
4. Add risk reversals or trust signals as needed

**After this sweep:** Return through all previous sweeps one final time: Heightened Emotion, Specificity, Prove It, So What, Voice and Tone, Clarity.

---

## Expert Panel Scoring

Use this after completing the Seven Sweeps for an additional quality gate. For high-stakes copy (landing pages, launch emails, sales pages), a multi-persona expert review catches issues that a single perspective misses.

### How It Works

1. **Assemble 3-5 expert personas** relevant to the copy type
2. **Each persona scores the copy 1-10** on their area of expertise
3. **Collect specific critiques** — not just scores, but what to fix
4. **Revise based on feedback** — address the lowest-scoring areas first
5. **Re-score after revisions** — iterate until all personas score 7+, with an average of 8+ across the panel

### Recommended Expert Panels

**Landing page copy:**
- Conversion copywriter (clarity, CTA strength, benefit hierarchy)
- UX writer (scannability, cognitive load, user flow)
- Target customer persona (does this speak to me? do I trust it?)
- Brand strategist (voice consistency, positioning accuracy)

**Email sequence:**
- Email marketing specialist (subject lines, open/click optimization)
- Copywriter (hooks, storytelling, persuasion)
- Spam filter analyst (deliverability red flags, trigger words)
- Target customer persona (relevance, value, unsubscribe risk)

**Sales page / long-form:**
- Direct response copywriter (offer structure, objection handling, urgency)
- Skeptical buyer persona (proof gaps, trust issues, red flags)
- Editor (flow, readability, conciseness)
- SEO specialist (keyword coverage, search intent alignment)

### Scoring Rubric

| Score | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| 9-10 | Publish-ready. No meaningful improvements. |
| 7-8 | Strong. Minor tweaks only. |
| 5-6 | Functional but has clear gaps. Needs another pass. |
| 3-4 | Significant issues. Major revision needed. |
| 1-2 | Fundamentally broken. Rethink approach. |

### When to Use

- **Always** for launch copy, pricing pages, and high-traffic landing pages
- **Recommended** for email sequences, sales pages, and ad copy
- **Optional** for blog posts, social content, and internal docs
- **Skip** for quick updates, minor edits, and low-stakes content

---

## Quick-Pass Editing Checks

Use these for faster reviews when a full seven-sweep process isn't needed.

### Word-Level Checks

**Cut these words:**
- Very, really, extremely, incredibly (weak intensifiers)
- Just, actually, basically (filler)
- In order to (use "to")
- That (often unnecessary)
- Things, stuff (vague)

**Replace these:**

| Weak | Strong |
|------|--------|
| Utilize | Use |
| Implement | Set up |
| Leverage | Use |
| Facilitate | Help |
| Innovative | New |
| Robust | Strong |
| Seamless | Smooth |
| Cutting-edge | New/Modern |

**Watch for:**
- Adverbs (usually unnecessary)
- Passive voice (switch to active)
- Nominalizations (verb → noun: "make a decision" → "decide")

### Sentence-Level Checks

- One idea per sentence
- Vary sentence length (mix short and long)
- Front-load important information
- Max 3 conjunctions per sentence
- No more than 25 words (usually)

### Paragraph-Level Checks

- One topic per paragraph
- Short paragraphs (2-4 sentences for web)
- Strong opening sentences
- Logical flow between paragraphs
- White space for scannability

---

## Copy Editing Checklist

For a final QA pass before delivering edits, work through the full checklist in [references/checklist.md](references/checklist.md) — covering all seven sweeps plus pre-start and final-check items.

---

## Common Copy Problems & Fixes

### Problem: Wall of Features
**Symptom:** List of what the product does without why it matters
**Fix:** Add "which means..." after each feature to bridge to benefits

### Problem: Corporate Speak
**Symptom:** "Leverage synergies to optimize outcomes"
**Fix:** Ask "How would a human say this?" and use those words

### Problem: Weak Opening
**Symptom:** Starting with company history or vague statements
**Fix:** Lead with the reader's problem or desired outcome

### Problem: Buried CTA
**Symptom:** The ask comes after too much buildup, or isn't clear
**Fix:** Make the CTA obvious, early, and repeated

### Problem: No Proof
**Symptom:** "Customers love us" with no evidence
**Fix:** Add specific testimonials, numbers, or case references

### Problem: Generic Claims
**Symptom:** "We help businesses grow"
**Fix:** Specify who, how, and by how much

### Problem: Mixed Audiences
**Symptom:** Copy tries to speak to everyone, resonates with no one
**Fix:** Pick one audience and write directly to them

### Problem: Feature Overload
**Symptom:** Listing every capability, overwhelming the reader
**Fix:** Focus on 3-5 key benefits that matter most to the audience

---

## Working with Copy Sweeps

When editing collaboratively:

1. **Run a sweep and present findings** - Show what you found, why it's an issue
2. **Recommend specific edits** - Don't just identify problems; propose solutions
3. **Request the updated copy** - Let the author make final decisions
4. **Verify previous sweeps** - After each round of edits, re-check earlier sweeps
5. **Repeat until clean** - Continue until a full sweep finds no new issues

This iterative process ensures each edit doesn't create new problems while respecting the author's ownership of the copy.

---

## References

- [Plain English Alternatives](references/plain-english-alternatives.md): Replace complex words with simpler alternatives
- [Content Refresh](references/content-refresh.md): Full checklist, refresh vs. rewrite matrix, and cadence guide
- [Copy Editing Checklist](references/checklist.md): Full QA checklist across all seven sweeps

---

## Content Refresh Editing

Copy editing isn't just for new content. Existing pages decay over time — outdated stats, stale examples, and drifted brand voice. Use the content refresh framework when traffic is declining, data is stale, or the product has changed.

**For the full refresh checklist, refresh vs. rewrite decision matrix, and cadence guide**: See [references/content-refresh.md](references/content-refresh.md)

---

## Task-Specific Questions

1. What's the goal of this copy? (Awareness, conversion, retention)
2. What action should readers take?
3. Are there specific concerns or known issues?
4. What proof/evidence do you have available?
5. Is this new copy or a refresh of existing content?

---

## Related Skills

- **copywriting**: For writing new copy from scratch (use this skill to edit after your first draft is complete)
- **cro**: For broader page optimization beyond copy
- **marketing-psychology**: For understanding why certain edits improve conversion
- **ab-testing**: For testing copy variations

---

## When to Use Each Skill

| Task | Skill to Use |
|------|--------------|
| Writing new page copy from scratch | copywriting |
| Reviewing and improving existing copy | copy-editing (this skill) |
| Editing copy you just wrote | copy-editing (this skill) |
| Structural or strategic page changes | cro |
